text:
Will: Quick kickoff — marketplace listing onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Short sync at 11:30 PT? Need owners for legal, packaging, billing, and images.
Maya: I can own GCP artifacts + deployment configs. will need sample terraform + container images.
Jess: I'll take AWS AMI + pricing SKU mapping. Ping eng-infra for AMI build IDs.
Arnold: I'll handle Azure offer packaging and publisher portal fields.
Priya (Legal): Legal will own EULA, DPA, and region-specific compliance check (EU). Need product description + data flow diagram by EOW.
Samir: I'll sketch SKU tiers and trial limits. Draft pricing matrix in the doc: https://redwood.app/sheets/marketplace-pricing (internal)
Will: Marketplace-bot, can you create the onboarding checklist and add owners?
marketplace-bot: Created checklist #MP-417: tasks: AMI IDs, GCP deployment package, Azure offer zip, EULA draft, pricing matrix, telemetry hooks. Due dates default +7d.
Jess: For AWS — infra asks for AMI naming convention. Suggest: redwood-inference-<model>-<date>-v1. I'll follow up with build job.
Maya: GCP needs deployment manager yaml + sample image URI. I'll add a sample:
```
resources:
  - name: inference-container
    type: gcp-types/cloudrun-v1:projects.locations.services
    properties:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
            - image: gcr.io/redwood/inference:stable-2026-03
```
Arnold: Azure wants offer manifest and plan ids. I'll create a placeholder manifest and request publisher onboarding access.
Priya (Legal): Also flag telemetry/PII: we need explicit consent language if we log user prompts. Samir, include that in product doc.
Samir: Noted — will add telemetry opt-out text and retention policy (30 days).
Will: Timeline proposal: initial artifacts by Thu EOD, legal sign-off Fri, staging listing tests next week. Is that workable?
Jess: Works for me if infra gives AMIs by Wed.
Maya: I can hit Thu EOD for GCP samples.
Arnold: Azure will need help with publisher account — may slip to Fri, but will target Fri.
Priya (Legal): I'll review as delivered; expect comments within 24h of submission.
marketplace-bot: Reminder set: deliverables check-in in 72h.
Will: Action summary:
- Jess: AWS AMIs + pricing SKU mapping
- Maya: GCP deployment YAML + container URIs
- Arnold: Azure offer manifest + plan IDs
- Priya: EULA/DPA + compliance checklist
- Samir: pricing tiers + telemetry text
I'll run a brief 15m stand tomorrow to surface blockers.
Jess: tagging eng-infra @sam for AMI pipeline.
Maya: @Will putting sample configs in /docs/marketplace/gcp/
Arnold: adding Azure manifest to /docs/marketplace/azure/
Priya (Legal): Uploading redline template to the drive once ready.
Samir: I'll post the initial pricing table this afternoon.
Will: Perfect — thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jess: :thumbsup:
Maya: :raised_hands:
Arnold: :+1:
Priya (Legal): :white_check_mark:
marketplace-bot: Checkpoint: next sync in 72h (176468? placeholder).
